title: MarketplaceListing
description: A public listing for a plugin, extension, app, or add-on in a marketplace such as VS Code Marketplace, JetBrains Marketplace, Chrome Web Store, Atlassian Marketplace, Shopify App Store, or Salesforce AppExchange.

publisher.description: Publisher account that owns this listing.

short_description.description: Short marketing description shown on listing cards.
short_description.example: AI pair programmer for your editor.

long_description.description: Full marketing description shown on the listing detail page.
long_description.example: Claude Code brings Anthropic's Claude model into your editor for code generation, refactoring, and review.

categories.description: Marketplace categories or tags the listing is filed under.

pricing_model.description: Pricing model used by the listing.

rating.description: Average user rating, on a 0 to 5 scale.

rating_count.description: Number of user ratings used to compute the average.

install_count.description: Cumulative install count reported by the marketplace.

verified.description: Whether the publisher is marked verified or partner by the marketplace.

listing_url.description: Canonical URL of the listing on the marketplace.

icon_url.description: URL of the listing icon or logo.

screenshots.description: URLs of marketing screenshots for the listing.

supports_hosts.description: Host platforms or product editions supported by this listing.

current_version.description: Latest published version of the plugin behind this listing.

last_updated.description: Timestamp of the most recent version published to this listing.
